_about: What milli must match: Pollen Robotics' microduck. 'published' from pollen-robotics.com/microduck and the press (cnx-software 2026-08-28; read 2026-11-02). 'model' values measured on microduck's own MJCF (pollen-robotics/microduck_rl, robot_walk.xml, its zero pose, knees bent; meshes CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, kept outside this repo) with the floor under its soles; metres. milli cannot be microduck's size with STS3215 legs (2026-11-02), so tools/checks.py compares PROPORTIONS: each 'model' value scaled by milli's height / microduck's, within 'tol' of that scaled value, and reports the height itself as a warning with the ratio.
mass_budget_note: 1.3 kg until 2026-11-02; raised to 1.35 when the SO-101-style servo mounts (cradles, forks, rear horns: 124 g) were modelled. Raised to 1.4 the same day for microduck's bearings (75 g of steel, less the forks they replace). Every pose's torque check still passes.

look.head: a big rounded hood, white on top, a grey face set in under its front edge, one round eye with a coloured ring, an orange bill along its lower edge that opens
look.body: a small white pillow-shaped shell over the hips
look.legs: bare black servos at the hips and knees, a white rounded-triangle plate over each thigh, bare ankle servos
